title: SEO Executive
description:
Job Description SEO Executive Company: CDK Travels Private Limited
 Department: Digital Marketing / SEO
 Experience: 03 Years
 Industry: Travel & Tourism
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a result-oriented and detail-focused SEO Executive to manage and improve the organic search performance of our travel websites. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of SEO strategies, keyword research, on-page and off-page optimization, and competitor analysis. 
 The candidate will be responsible for improving search engine rankings, driving organic traffic, and optimizing travel-related website pages, including tour packages, destination guides, visa services, and travel blogs. 
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 Conduct keyword research focused on travel-related searches, including tour packages, destinations, flight bookings, visa services, and travel-related queries. Optimize website pages, blogs, landing pages, and service pages for targeted travel keywords through effective on-page SEO. Manage off-page SEO activities, including quality backlink building, travel directory submissions, guest posting, and outreach campaigns. Work on SEO strategies for tour package pages, destination pages, travel guides, and other travel-related website content. Monitor website performance, organic traffic, and keyword rankings using Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, and other SEO tools. Conduct competitor analysis to identify keyword opportunities, backlink gaps, and strategies to improve search visibility. Coordinate with content writers to develop SEO-friendly travel blogs, destination guides, itineraries, and website content. Identify website SEO issues and coordinate with the technical team to implement necessary improvements. Track keyword performance, organic growth, and SEO campaign results and prepare regular performance reports. Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, SEO best practices, and emerging trends in the travel and tourism industry. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 03 years of hands-on experience in SEO, preferably in the travel and tourism industry. Experience working on travel websites, tour packages, destination-based websites, or similar projects. Understanding of travel-related search intent, keyword research, and seasonal search trends. Practical experience with SEO tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms. Good understanding of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and basic technical SEO. Knowledge of backlink analysis, link-building strategies, and competitor research. Ability to work closely with content writers and understand SEO-friendly content requirements. Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Immediate joiners and candidates with relevant travel industry experience will be preferred. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 Someone who understands practical SEO implementation rather than just theoretical concepts. A proactive individual who can identify ranking opportunities and improve organic search performance. Someone comfortable working with multiple travel websites and managing SEO activities independently. 
 Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume, highlighting their SEO experience and relevant website projects.

Key Skills: Webmaster,Link building,Console,Engine,Off-page optimization,SEO Tools,Site analysis,Site

title: Paid Marketing Expert
company: Shree Guru Gobind Singh Tricentenary University (SGTU)
description:
Organisation: SGT University
 Department: Branding & Communications
 Location: Gurugram, Haryana
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Experience: 5+ Years 
 ROLE OVERVIEW SGT University is looking for an experienced Paid Marketing & Performance Marketing Expert to plan, execute, manage and optimise digital advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube and other relevant platforms. The role will focus on driving quality student enquiries, generating admission leads, improving campaign performance, optimising advertising budgets and maximising conversions through data-driven marketing strategies. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in paid advertising, performance marketing, lead generation, audience targeting, campaign analytics and conversion optimisation. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Paid Campaign Management Plan, execute and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads and other relevant platforms. Develop performance-driven campaign strategies aligned with university admission and lead-generation objectives. Manage campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience segmentation and budget allocation. 2. Lead Generation & Performance Marketing Develop and execute strategies to generate high-quality student enquiries and admission leads. Monitor lead volume, lead quality, Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL) and conversion rates. Coordinate with the admissions team to evaluate lead quality and identify opportunities for improving conversions. Optimise campaigns to achieve efficient lead acquisition and improved marketing performance. 3. Budget Management & Optimisation Plan and manage advertising budgets across multiple digital platforms. Monitor campaign spending and ensure efficient budget utilisation. Identify opportunities to reduce acquisition costs and improve campaign returns. Scale high-performing campaigns based on performance insights. 4. Search & Audience Marketing Plan and execute Google Search, Display and YouTube advertising campaigns. Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis and competitor analysis. Develop audience targeting and remarketing strategies to improve campaign effectiveness. Monitor keyword performance, CPC, search impression share and conversions. 5. Creative & Conversion Optimisation Coordinate with creative and content teams for campaign creatives, ad copies and promotional requirements. Conduct A/B testing of creatives, headlines, ad copies, audiences and campaign structures. Monitor creative-wise performance and recommend improvements. Optimise landing pages, enquiry forms and campaign funnels to improve conversion rates. 6. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting Ensure accurate implementation and monitoring of Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, GA4, conversion tracking and UTM parameters. Analyse campaign performance using relevant analytics and advertising tools. Prepare regular performance reports covering campaign spend, leads, CPL, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversion rates. Provide actionable insights and recommendations for continuous campaign improvement. 7. Industry Updates & Best Practices Stay updated with the latest developments in digital advertising platforms, tools, formats and performance marketing strategies. Identify new opportunities, trends and technologies to enhance digital campaign performance. 
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Paid Marketing, Performance Marketing or Digital Advertising. Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and YouTube Ads. Proven experience in managing and optimising high-budget digital advertising campaigns. Strong understanding of campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience targeting, remarketing and conversion optimisation. Hands-on experience in lead generation and performance-driven marketing campaigns. Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Pixel and UTM tracking. Strong understanding of CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, CPQL, ROAS and conversion metrics. Experience in landing page optimisation, A/B testing and campaign funnel analysis. Strong analytical, reporting and data interpretation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets. Ability to independently plan, execute, monitor and optimise paid marketing campaigns. 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATION Experience in the education sector, particularly universities, colleges or educational institutions, will be an added advantage. Experience in student admission campaigns, education lead generation and enrolment-focused marketing will be preferred. Graduate/Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration or a related discipline.

Key Skills: Marketing,Searching,Paid Marketing,Google,Google Ads,Reporting,Optimization,Budget management
